about: Things joined by their relations, laid out so linked things sit together, each arriving as it is named, links drawn as lines or arrows with a word on them: who knows whom, what feeds what, how ideas connect, a web of influences.

links.about: links split by |: A>B is an arrow, A-B a line, A>B:word puts a word on it

alone.about: things with no links, split by |

highlight.about: things drawn larger in the accent, split by |

when.about: moments each thing arrives, in the order first named in links; else when its name is said, or one after another
